tasks.label: Deploy frontend to Oracle
tasks.detail: Build the frontend and upload it to https://140-238-209-178.sslip.io (needs the strategy-lab host in ~/.ssh/config)

windows.command: ssh strategy-lab 'find /var/www/strategy-trading-lab -mindepth 1 -delete'; if ($?) { scp -r frontend/dist/. strategy-lab:/var/www/strategy-trading-lab/ }; if ($?) { curl.exe -fsS -o NUL -w 'Live: HTTP %{http_code}\n' https://140-238-209-178.sslip.io/ }

tasks.label: Deploy backend to Oracle
tasks.detail: Build the API for the server and install it as a new release behind https://140-238-209-178.sslip.io/api/ (needs the strategy-lab host in ~/.ssh/config)

tasks.label: Deploy backend environment to Oracle
tasks.detail: Upload deploy/backend/production.env to the server as api.env and restart the API (needs the strategy-lab host in ~/.ssh/config)
